gold_source.role: development source; not future OOS or independent replication

cpi.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics annual release calendars

employment.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics annual release calendars

fomc.source: Federal Reserve FOMC meeting calendar and statements

event_state_definition.bar_time_semantics: source timestamp is one-minute bar open time UTC
event_state_definition.pre_event_price: close of bar opening one minute before scheduled event
event_state_definition.initial_reaction_end_price: close of bar opening 14 minutes after scheduled event
event_state_definition.pre_event_scale: high-low range across the 120 complete one-minute bars ending one minute before event
event_state_definition.interpretation: positive is continuation of the initial event shock; negative is reversal after the initial shock
event_state_definition.zero_initial_reaction: drop event from directional state scoring

matched_placebo_control.event_excess_continuation: event continuation score minus median valid matched-placebo continuation score
matched_placebo_control.purpose: control ordinary same-time intraday continuation/reversal unrelated to the frozen scheduled event

trend_4h.note: pre-event trend is known before the event; alignment uses the subsequent initial shock direction

compression.definition: pre_event_120m_range / median full-day high-low range of the prior 20 completed New York trading dates

primary_hypotheses.statistic: median continuation_score when alignment=+1 minus median continuation_score when alignment=-1
Spearman correlation between compression and continuation_score
Spearman correlation between shock_size and continuation_score

statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across all six primary hypotheses

state_gate.event_type_robustness_for_pooled_feature: primary-horizon effect sign must agree in at least two of three event types when each subtype has at least 8 scorable events
